bugs.title: LED driven on D12 instead of D13
bugs.description: setup() and loop() configure and write pin 12, so the user LED on D13 never lights; the button state is mirrored onto the wrong pin.

cases.patched_sketch:
void setup(){pinMode(2,INPUT_PULLUP);pinMode(13,OUTPUT);}
void loop(){ digitalWrite(13, digitalRead(2)==LOW ? HIGH : LOW); }

bugs.title: No hysteresis on fan threshold
bugs.description: Fan turns OFF as soon as temp drops below 28 °C instead of staying ON until 24 °C, causing rapid toggling around the setpoint.

bugs.title: No fail-safe for floating/out-of-range sensor
bugs.description: Floating sensor (near 0 V) or out-of-range temps do not force the fan ON; a disconnected sensor reads ~0 °C and turns the fan OFF, and >100 °C is not handled specially.

bugs.title: Wrong unit scaling (10 mV/°C)
bugs.description: Code assumes 100 °C per 5 V (50 mV/°C) but the sensor is 10 mV/°C, so reported temperature is 5× too high and the 28 °C threshold trips at ~5.6 °C actual.

cases.patched_sketch:
void setup(){pinMode(2,INPUT_PULLUP);pinMode(13,OUTPUT);}
void loop(){ digitalWrite(13, digitalRead(2)==LOW ? LOW : HIGH); }
